description: Start a fresh StockLens analysis of one company, only when the person asks for one or agrees to an offer of one in a get_market_summary result. A new run may use one Analysis credit, or one Plus Analysis credit when depth is plus; the result says if the person's plan does not include it. Use inspect_reading for already-produced evidence when its exact reference is available; an evidence question alone never authorizes a run. Both depths include written domain summaries and synthesis when produced; Plus adds deeper synthesis and extra web cards where available. The assistant result is condensed; the saved web report has the factor cards and Explain views. It waits up to 9 seconds for the analysis's scores and returns them in result with its analysis_id when they are ready, otherwise its analysis_id and current status. When there is no result, or narrative.status is pending or running, call fetch_analysis_result with that analysis_id right away; it waits for what is still being written. new_run_started and reused_existing say whether a recent matching analysis was reused. One ticker per call. It does not rank or compare companies, and does not trade or move money.

analysis_emphasis.description: Optional. RISK_EMPHASIS | BALANCED | FUNDAMENTAL_GROWTH_EMPHASIS. Must agree with the emphasis implied by analysis_focus (low->RISK_EMPHASIS, medium->BALANCED, high->FUNDAMENTAL_GROWTH_EMPHASIS); a mismatch is rejected as a validation error before any credit is consumed.

analysis_focus.description: Analysis focus: low=Defensive, medium=Balanced, high=Growth. Default medium. Reweights downside/quality risk versus growth/fundamentals, never the underlying facts. Not a personal risk or suitability assessment.

depth.description: Analysis depth: standard or plus. Both include written domain summaries and synthesis when produced. Plus uses deeper synthesis and adds extra cards in the web report where available. Standard uses an Analysis credit (LENS_AI); Plus uses a Plus Analysis credit (LENS_AI_PLUS). Default standard.

evidence_history_family.description: Optional. SHORT_HISTORY | MEDIUM_HISTORY | LONG_HISTORY. Must agree with the family implied by time_range (short_2_wk->SHORT_HISTORY, medium_1_mo/medium_2_mo->MEDIUM_HISTORY, long_1_yr/long_2_yr->LONG_HISTORY); a mismatch is rejected as a validation error before any credit is consumed. Does not select a representative range on its own.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. NASDAQ). Optional. Resolved automatically if omitted.

risk_tolerance.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for analysis_focus. Use analysis_focus for new calls. If both are supplied they must agree (case-insensitive).

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL). Exactly one ticker per call.

time_range.description: Intended holding period, looking forward from the analysis date. Shorter horizons give recent price action, momentum and news more emphasis than longer ones; longer horizons give business fundamentals and quality more emphasis. Input history can span longer periods. Does not predict price or returns. One window per calibrated band: short_2_wk (Short-term), medium_1_mo (Medium-term), long_1_yr (Long-term). Default medium_1_mo. The legacy medium_2_mo and long_2_yr aliases are still accepted and resolve to medium_1_mo and long_1_yr respectively.

name: initiate_analysis

company_name.description: The listing's company name, when resolution named it

message.description: Which analysis was started or reused, naming the company, ticker and exchange; relay it as written

result.description: The analysis's saved result, as fetch_analysis_result returns it, when its scores were stored while this call waited; absent when the status is pending

base_digest.description: Identifies the saved scores and evidence of a complete result. It stays the same when the written summaries arrive.

deterministic_ready_at.description: When the scores and evidence were saved, ahead of the written summaries (ISO 8601). Absent when the report was saved together with its summaries.

reading_ref.description: Exact reading_ref returned by StockLens. Never reconstruct from a ticker or date.

selector.description: Copy the selector from inspection.arguments, including an optional overview continuation. Required for other views.

view.description: Copy from inspection.arguments; default overview. Only overview, finding, assessment or observation.

label.description: Subject label for selecting a view; read the selected result for its material context and bindings.

message.description: A sentence to relay as given: while in_progress, the analysis's actual stage; on a complete result, whether its written summaries are still being written or could not be completed. Never invent or rotate progress narration.

narrative.description: The state of the written summaries (the domain conclusions, the synthesis, and the key strengths and challenges) of a complete result.

error_code.description: Why the written summaries failed, as a diagnostic code.

ready_at.description: When the written summaries became ready (ISO 8601).

revision.description: Rises with every change of the summaries' state; a higher revision is the newer answer.

status.description: pending or running: still being written, and not in this result. ready: in this result. failed: could not be completed; the scores and evidence are unaffected.

report_url.description: Open this saved report for factor values, peer context and ranked contributors through Explain where supplied. Sign in to the owning StockLens account. Reading it does not start another analysis. Present with every complete result, which has passed ownership checks; the report can open before its written summaries finish.

sentiment_sources_note.description: The Sentiment evidence this reading did not use and why, as one sentence to relay as given, for example: Evidence not read in this analysis: earnings calls (none found recently).

risk_tolerance.description: Historical response alias for analysis_focus; new responses use the canonical key.

risk_tolerance_display.description: Historical response alias for analysis_focus_display; new responses use the canonical key.

ticker.description: The listing the analysis is of: its ticker as StockLens holds it

title: Initiate Analysis
